article.story: HOUSTON -- — Trenton McLaughlin had 20 points including a 3-pointer with two seconds remaining in Northern Arizona's 74-71 win over Houston Christian on Wednesday night. McLaughlin also contributed five rebounds for the Lumberjacks (6-2). Carson Towt scored 14 points and added eight rebounds. Diego Campisano went 3 of 4 from the field (2 for 3 from 3-point range) to finish with nine points. Elijah Brooks led the way for the Huskies (2-5) with 29 points, six rebounds and two steals. Houston Christian also got 28 points and eight rebounds from Julian Mackey. Peyton Rogers also recorded six points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
